close_reason: added cert_is_ca and cert_path_len_constraint using x509-cert BasicConstraints; path_len_constraint was already Option<u8> in x509-cert 0.2
description:
Implement helpers to extract BasicConstraints from a Certificate for use in the §6.1 state machine.

RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9: BasicConstraints is CRITICAL on CA certs. Fields: cA BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, pathLenConstraint INTEGER OPTIONAL.

Functions needed:
  cert_is_ca(cert: &Certificate) -> Option<bool>
    Returns Some(true/false) if BasicConstraints extension is present, None if absent.
    Absence means cA=FALSE per RFC 5280.
  
  cert_path_len_constraint(cert: &Certificate) -> Option<u8>
    Returns the pathLenConstraint if present in BasicConstraints, None otherwise.

Usage in §6.1 state machine:
  - Every certificate in chain[1..] (intermediates) must have cA=TRUE. Absence or cA=FALSE → Error::NotCA { index }
  - pathLenConstraint on cert[i] means at most that many more intermediate certs are allowed above cert[i]. State machine variable max_path_length tracks this.
  - RFC 5280 §6.1.4(l): if isCA and pathLenConstraint present and current path depth > pathLenConstraint → Error::PathTooLong (or a dedicated variant)

Implementation note: x509-cert may have BasicConstraints decoded already in x509_cert::ext::pkix::BasicConstraints. Prefer that over manual DER parsing.

Test vectors: use PKITS §4.6 BasicConstraints test certificates.
title: pkix-path: BasicConstraints and pathLenConstraint extraction
